summary: Independent audit of tracy/0.13.1 conan recipe adaptation. All critical checks passed: (1) sha256 verified against conandata.yml (d4efc50ebcb0bfcfdbba148995aeb75044c0d80f5d91223aebfaa8fa9e563d2b); (2) all 3 patches apply cleanly and were verified against local orig/source tree before commit; (3) test_package/test.cpp contains 22 real Tracy API invocations + 3 runtime asserts (NOT a hello-world shell); (4) libTracyClient.a builds + links + runs under OHOS clang 15 + libc++ + C++17; (5) ctest 100% pass (1/1 Test #1: test_tracy ... Passed 0.14 sec); (6) conan-verify 8 gates G0/G1/G2/G3/G4/L2/L4/L5 all PASS; (7) R36 satisfied (0 external deps); (8) R26 satisfied (libTracyClient.a is static, system_libs only pthread+dl); (9) R32 satisfied (settings.os=OHOS via profile); (10) R34 satisfied (test_package calls API + has 3 asserts); (11) MANIFEST.yml upstream_tests/test_package_tests both populated with file paths and descriptions; (12) PR.md follows .gitcode/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md structure with full upstream-vs-adapted test comparison table and patch descriptions. No P0 (deception) or P1 (correctness) issues found. One P3 (doc-completeness) issue identified and fixed during audit.
